movenet_lightning_research.input_format: RGB image normalized to [0, 255] or float32 depending on preprocessing
movenet_lightning_research.output_keypoint_format: 17 keypoints: [y, x, confidence] normalized in range [0.0, 1.0]
movenet_lightning_research.official_onnx_note: Google TF Hub hosts only TFLite and SavedModel formats; no official Google-provided ONNX file is published.

compatibility_assessment.detailed_reason: 1) Official MoveNet TFLite files cannot be loaded by cv2.dnn because OpenCV 5.0.0 lacks support for the ARG_MAX operator used in MoveNet's peak detection sub-graph. 2) Google does not host official ONNX files on TF Hub (conversion requires tf2onnx or PyTorch). 3) Neither tensorflow nor tflite_runtime is installed in the current environment.
compatibility_assessment.action_taken: Stopped per rule 6 without downloading unauthorized community mirrors or installing new packages.

smallest_safe_next_options.benefit: Enables direct, zero-code-change execution of Google's official Apache-2.0 MoveNet SinglePose Lightning TFLite model directly on CPU.
Includes Google's official BlazePose pose landmark pipeline directly via CPU, extracting 33 landmarks without needing PyTorch or external ONNX converters.
